title: 12 NYCRR § 142-2.3 — Overtime rate — exceptions
content:
12 NYCRR § 142-2.3

(a) An employer shall pay an employee for overtime at a wage rate of one and one-half times the employee's regular rate in accordance with section 142-2.2, except as otherwise provided in this Part or by statute.
(b) Nothing in this Part relieves an employer of obligations under the Fair Labor Standards Act when that Act applies.

sections.content: NY Part 142 overtime exceptions and FLSA interaction.

sourceMetadata.sourceOwner: New York State Department of Labor
